overview_description.description:
Bunting Labs provides a GIS analytic sandbox that visualizes findings, displays geometries, and auto-completes features from datasets. They're automating map digitization into GIS data and developing APIs to integrate their client's software with the world's population, sites of interest, and local characteristics.

Bunting Labs is headquartered in San Francisco, California and was founded in 2022.

about_short_description.short_description: Bunting Labs provides a GIS analytic sandbox that visualizes findings, displays geometries, and auto-completes features from datasets.

product.name: AI Vectorizer
product.description: A QGIS plugin that uses AI to digitize map features from raster images, reducing manual vectorization time by about half.

product.name: AI Georeferencer
product.description: An AI-powered tool within QGIS that automatically places control points to georeference maps and aerial imagery, streamlining the georeferencing process.

product.name: Map Legal Descriptions with AI
product.description: A web-based AI service that converts legal property descriptions from PDFs into vector geometries like DXF and Shapefiles for GIS and CAD use.

product.name: Kue AI Assistant for QGIS
product.description: An AI chatbot plugin for QGIS that assists with geoprocessing, styling, labeling, dataset search, and OpenStreetMap data extraction.

product.name: OpenStreetMap Extracts API
product.description: A REST API that allows users to download filtered OpenStreetMap data as GeoJSON by tag and bounding box for integration into GIS workflows.
